courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 船舶艙室防火分區
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以平面環境力合成建立起點，接到位置回授時間差的系統介面，最後用力平衡模型與實船DP界線整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Combining planar environmental loads, connect through Position-feedback delay, then integrate evidence using Model versus vessel-DP boundary. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 船舶動態定位概念
history.text: 本專題以平面環境力合成建立起點，接到位置回授時間差的系統介面，最後用力平衡模型與實船DP界線整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Combining planar environmental loads, connect through Position-feedback delay, then integrate evidence using Model versus vessel-DP boundary. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 在桌面力向量模型平衡風流擾動與推力，練習失去一個量測或致動通道時的證據判讀。 在民用定位力向量模擬室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Balance environmental loads and thrust in a tabletop vector model and interpret loss of one sensor/actuator channel. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Civil station-keeping force-vector simulator. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
